name: Peru

flag.description: Three equal vertical bands of red, white and red; the state flag adds the coat of arms in the centre of the white band.
flag.symbolism: Red is commonly said to represent the blood shed for independence and white peace; tradition says José de San Martín was inspired by a flock of red and white flamingos.

hook: Peru is red-white-red standing up with three equal bands; Canada's white centre is twice as wide and holds a maple leaf.
trivia: The coat of arms shows a vicuña, a cinchona tree and a cornucopia spilling coins, representing the animal, plant and mineral riches of the country.
Lake Titicaca, on the border of Peru and Bolivia, is often described as the highest navigable lake in the world.
